Only 22% of 4,269 active remote USD listings actually state a salary figure. The other 78% leave you negotiating without a baseline.

We analyzed Loker Dollar's remote-job data (queried 13 Oct 2026). Key numbers:

- 4,269 active remote listings; 939 (22%) disclose pay
- 2,725 listings (64%) are open to applicants worldwide
- 1,205 were posted in the last 7 days
- AI appears in 12% of listings; communication in 39%
- Top disclosed roles: OpenAI Data Scientist USD 293k-325k/yr; Equinix Chief of Staff USD 195k-319k/yr

The practical take: don't chase 'average' USD pay. Filter for roles where the range is explicit, check freshness, and apply fast in a market this quick.

Read the full breakdown: https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/best-remote-usd-jobs
